Faculty extends User; its binding may access inherited features. Bind subtype-only features through Faculty; a type-test branch alone does not narrow a base-typed OCL binding in this backend.

RecommendBook extends Book; its binding may access inherited features. Bind subtype-only features through RecommendBook; a type-test branch alone does not narrow a base-typed OCL binding in this backend.
Student extends User; its binding may access inherited features. Bind subtype-only features through Student; a type-test branch alone does not narrow a base-typed OCL binding in this backend.
BorrowStatus: use only BorrowStatus::NORMAL, BorrowStatus::SUSPEND. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
CopyStatus: use only CopyStatus::AVAILABLE, CopyStatus::INPROCESSING, CopyStatus::LIBUSEONLY, CopyStatus::LOANED, CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Position: use only Position::ASSISTANTPROFESSORS, Position::ASSOCIATEPROFESSOR, Position::CHAIRPROFESSOR, Position::PROFESSOR. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Programme: use only Programme::BACHELOR, Programme::MASTER, Programme::PHD. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Sex: use only Sex::F, Sex::M. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Status: use only Status::HASRETIRED, Status::INPOSITION. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
StudentStatus: use only StudentStatus::GRADUATED, StudentStatus::PROGRAMMING. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Parameter uid: String. Reference it as uid, not self.uid; preserve its declared name and type.
The operation returns Set(RecommendBook). Use result only in the postcondition, with a compatible value satisfying the stated return obligation; do not assume a Boolean result is true.
